versions.changelog:
keyapi-threads-user-discovery v1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill for discovering and analyzing Threads users and content via KeyAPI.
- Retrieve user profiles by username or user ID; fetch posts, reposts, replies, post details, and comments.
- Perform keyword-based searches across top content, recent content, and user profiles.
- Detailed workflow guides and node usage documentation included for efficient API integration.
- Requires a free KeyAPI token and Node.js v18+.
